This single-bladed turquoise '''lightsaber''' was used by [[Tenel Ka Djo]], a member of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[New Jedi Order]]. It was built in [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]] on the [[Yavin 4/Legends|fourth]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]], and the second of two very similar weapons.

For her first lightsaber, Tenel Ka carved intricate battle etchings into the hilt of her saber, one of two of the smaller [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] that once belonged to her great-grandmother [[Augwynne Djo]]'s favorite [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]]. She then applied a black paste made from dampened volcanic sand and polished the tooth until it brought out the carvings into sharp relief. The young [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi apprentice]] used [[Magma/Legends|lava]] [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] that she later discovered to be flawed, producing a gray-white blade, that she had found in a local [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]] lava tube. The hollow of the tooth was also a little too small for the crystal arrangement that she wanted, but having earlier learned that her friends were much further along in the construction of their lightsabers, this gave her a sense of urgency to complete her weapon and decided to go ahead and make do with what she had. Tenel Ka believed that any deficiencies in a weapon could be overcome by her skills as a warrior, not taking into account that a lightsaber is an energy weapon. The flawed crystals combined in an un-ideal arrangement resulted in a defective lightsaber.

During an ill-fated sparring exercise with her fellow apprentice [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], her lightsaber's power source overloaded in the middle of an intense blade lock, and the blade disappeared. Focused on their sparring, the sudden loss of resistance took Solo completely by surprise. Unable to withdraw his lightsaber in time, he unintentionally severed Tenel Ka's left [[Limb/Legends|arm]] just above the elbow; the faulty lightsaber fell to the ground, exploding and destroyed the lost forearm with it, leaving nothing to be reattached.

[[File:Tenel_Ka_Djo_lightsaber_EGF.jpg|thumb|left|An adult Tenel Ka and her lightsaber]]
Later, after recovering at [[Reef Fortress]] on [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]] and helping to foil an assassination attempt on herself and her paternal grandmother, [[Ta'a Chume]]&mdash;[[Queen Mother]] of the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]]&mdash;Tenel Ka decided to continue her Jedi training and to rebuild her lightsaber. In an attempt to reconcile the best aspects of her mixed heritage, she used the second rancor tooth from [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], a planet that was wild, untamed, fierce and proud (this time forgoing the battle etchings of the first one) and several [[Rainbow gem|Gallinorean rainbow gems]] picked out from the remains of the tiara of the [[Prince/Legends|Royal Princess]] of [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]], her inheritance of regal bearing, refinement, power, wealth, and political shrewdness.<ref name="YJKL" />
